A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the multiplicity yields at LHC energies can be described by the MGM model with a single parameter k=0.35, tuned previously at lower energies, with a good accuracy.
we are able to reproduce the data on the mean multiplicity at $\sqrt{s_{NN}}$ = 5.5 TeV, 7.2 TeV, and 8.8 TeV with a good precision.
the MGM is a very good predictive tool for the multiplicity in Pb-Pb collisions, and it is a very good tool for the multiparticle production at the LHC energies, in general.
